title: Apply File Redirection
goal: Configure standard streams to read from or write to specified files before execution.

narrative.hook: Your shell can successfully parse redirection operators from command tokens, but it still prints everything to the terminal and waits for interactive keyboard input.
narrative.motivation: Without connecting these stream instructions to actual file operations, users cannot save output logs or feed file contents into automated data processing pipelines.
narrative.concrete_demo: Imagine running a command that generates system stats and instantly saving those results into a persistent text file for later review, freeing your screen from text clutter.

learning_objectives: Understand how to configure standard input and output streams for process execution using specified file targets.
Ensure standard streams are properly connected to target files before executing external commands.
constraints: Do not alter the behavior of commands when no redirection operators are provided.
Handle file opening errors gracefully without crashing the shell process.
deliverables: A mechanism to route standard streams to and from specified files during command execution.

behaviors.description: Configure standard input and standard output streams to use designated file descriptors or targets before launching commands.

tests.description: Verifies that standard output can be saved to a file target correctly.
tests.expected_behavior: Command output is successfully written into the designated target file instead of the console.

tests.description: Verifies that standard input can be loaded from a file target correctly.
tests.expected_behavior: Command reads its standard input from the specified source file instead of the terminal.

tests.description: Verifies correct handling of non-existent files during stream redirection setup.
tests.expected_behavior: The shell catches the file access error, reports an appropriate message, and avoids crashing.

tests.description: Performs dynamic validation of stream redirection under varied runtime inputs.
tests.expected_behavior: Ensures streams are correctly configured across diverse file names and operational conditions.
